current_state.zh: Cloudflare 已聘用整个 Deno 团队，Deno 运行时进入为期一年的仅错误修复和安全更新阶段后停止官方开发；Deno Deploy 将在6个月后关闭，客户迁至 Cloudflare Workers；JSR 继续运营并迁移基础设施至 Cloudflare；Ryan Dahl 和 Bert Belder 负责将 celld 整合进 workerd。
current_state.en: Cloudflare has hired the entire Deno team, Deno runtime enters a one-year bug-fix and security-update-only phase before official development ceases; Deno Deploy will shut down in six months with customers migrated to Cloudflare Workers; JSR continues operating with infrastructure moving to Cloudflare; Ryan Dahl and Bert Belder are tasked with integrating celld into workerd.

updates.what_changed_zh: Cloudflare正在收购Deno，Deno自身的运行时开发将逐步收尾，先进行为期一年的每月漏洞修复和安全更新，随后结束，项目将保持开源，但不再由其原团队提供支持。
updates.what_changed_en: Cloudflare is acquiring Deno, and Deno's own runtime development will wind down to a year of monthly bug-fix and security releases before ending, leaving the project open source but unsupported by its original team.

updates.detailed_summary_zh: Cloudflare has hired the entire Deno team, prompting the Deno runtime to enter a one-year error-fix and security-update-only phase before official development ceases, Deno Deploy to shut down in six months, and Ryan Dahl to focus on merging Deno's distributed celld project with Cloudflare's workerd engine.
